extracted.intended_audience: prospective authors and print/digital subscribers of Asimov's Science Fiction
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural FAQs and submission guidance for authors sending fiction to Asimov's Science Fiction (includes submission method, tracking, and where to find detailed Writer's Guidelines), plus related subscriber/digital-file policies that affect access and distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult Writer's Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: See the Writer’s Guidelines for information on how to submit your manuscript, as well as questions relating to cover art, rights, and turnaround time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Writer’s Guidelines are the primary source for submission formatting, rights, cover art policies, and expected response/turnaround details; contact editorial office only for questions not answered there.

rubrics_metrics.name: No email submissions — use online submissions system
rubrics_metrics.description: Asimov’s does not accept email submissions. Submissions must be made via the online submissions system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The online system is used to streamline the process and improve communication with authors. Do not send manuscripts to the editorial email address for submission purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission confirmation and tracking number
rubrics_metrics.description: After submitting via the online submissions system, a tracking number will be displayed and an automated email confirmation containing this information will be sent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you do not receive the confirmation email within 24 hours, notify the magazine by email. Use the tracking number to monitor your submission status on the submissions website. The staff cannot track every submission individually — retain your tracking number and be patient.

rubrics_metrics.name: Print subscription first-issue delivery timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: First issue of a newly placed print subscription typically arrives in 6–8 weeks (domestic).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subscriptions shipping outside the United States may take 8–12 weeks for delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Print subscription customer-service contact protocol
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact Customer Service for problems with print subscriptions; include your name and full address and clearly state the problem.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not send subscription problems to the editorial address (they cannot solve subscription issues). Use the Customer Service email or phone as provided on the site.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to change mailing address for print subscription
rubrics_metrics.description: Three methods: change online; email customer service with both old and new addresses; or mail a written change including both old and new addresses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When emailing or writing, remember to include both the old and the new address to ensure correct updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Print subscription cancellation/transfer policy
rubrics_metrics.description: If dissatisfied, you may transfer the remainder of your subscription to another title, or cancel and get a full refund on all un-mailed issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact Customer Service and include the magazine title, your name, mailing address, and customer number (on your mailing label) to expedite service.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital file reading requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: To read ePub and PDF files you need a reader and/or app — e.g., Amazon Kindle (Send to Kindle), B&N Nook, Kobo (iOS/Android), Adobe Digital Editions, Apple Books, or Adobe Acrobat Reader on desktop.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Desktop reading requires either an ePub reader (for ePub) or Adobe Acrobat (for PDF). The listed options are common but other devices/apps may work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Third-party software/devices warranty disclaimer
rubrics_metrics.description: All devices and software for reading ePub and PDF files are third-party owned and independent of Asimov’s and its vendors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Asimov’s, Must Read Magazines, and 1 Paragraph, Inc. provide no warranty for the use of those devices or software.

rubrics_metrics.name: Where/how to purchase digital subscriptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Digital subscriptions must be ordered online via the site’s purchase link.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Digital subscriptions cannot be ordered by calling Customer Service; a personal secure ACCOUNT is required to buy digital subscriptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital technical support routing
rubrics_metrics.description: If you purchased your digital magazine on Asimovs.com, contact Asimov’s for support; if you purchased through another e-retailer, contact that retailer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The retailer is usually best positioned to assist with device-specific issues; Asimov’s can assist purchases made on their site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account required for digital subscriptions
rubrics_metrics.description: A personal, secure ACCOUNT is required to obtain and manage digital subscriptions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Account lets you view purchases, update address/billing/password, and access all issues you've purchased.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account capabilities for digital subscribers
rubrics_metrics.description: From your secure Account you can view purchase history and active subscriptions, update billing and password, and access purchased issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Downloads section in your Account to retrieve links to purchased issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Email notifications sender and safe-list instruction
rubrics_metrics.description: Issue emails are sent from asimovs-orders@mustreadbookspublishing.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add this address to your safe contacts list to ensure delivery to your inbox.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital issues availability duration in Account
rubrics_metrics.description: Issues remain available in your Account for 12 months.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Download files to your device to ensure continued access beyond the 12-month availability window.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital subscriptions must be ordered separately
rubrics_metrics.description: Digital subscriptions must be ordered separately from other products.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not attempt to combine digital subscriptions with print or other product purchases on the order.

rubrics_metrics.name: Order records are site-specific
rubrics_metrics.description: Each Must Read Magazines site is separate; order records and Downloads are visible only on the site where the order was placed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You cannot view orders made on another Must Read Magazines site from this site’s Account area.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy and credit-card information handling
rubrics_metrics.description: Personal information is securely held in your Account; credit-card information is maintained securely by the credit-card processing company and is not stored by Asimov’s.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You may update payment information from your secure Account at any time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital billing/publication schedule
rubrics_metrics.description: New issues are published every two months on the 8th of February, April, June, August, October, and December and you will be billed on those dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Billing occurs shortly before delivery using the credit card on file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital delivery timing and access
rubrics_metrics.description: When an order is transacted, links to issues are immediately available in the Downloads section of your Account and are also emailed to you.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issues are delivered as soon as the order is transacted using the card on file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cancel a digital subscription/format
rubrics_metrics.description: You can cancel your digital subscription or digital format at any time through your Account.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use your Account management tools to perform cancellations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ownership and download recommendation for purchased digital issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Purchased digital issues are yours to keep and remain available in Downloads for 12 months.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be sure to download purchased files to your own device to ensure continued access after the 12-month availability period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on sharing digital issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Digital issues are for personal enjoyment only and may not be shared; each friend should buy their own issue.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sharing is not permitted under the subscription/ purchase terms described.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital back-issues availability on Asimovs.com
rubrics_metrics.description: Back issues are not currently available for purchase on Asimovs.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To obtain back issues, check the Customer Service department or authorized dealers (listed on the site) for availability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital-only anthologies availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Asimov’s publishes digital-only anthologies for their fiction titles, including Asimov’s Science Fiction, available at e-retailers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anthologies may be purchased through third-party e-retailers linked from the site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of recent print back issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Recent print back issues, depending on supply, are available directly from Customer Service (cover price plus shipping).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Email Customer Service with the issues you'd like; staff will respond with availability, pricing, and payment options. The site also lists dealers known to sell back issues.
